title: Unveiling Sediment Deposition Thresholds in Discontinuous Emergent Vegetation Patches Using a SHAP-Interpretable Ensemble Machine Learning
summary: Using 498 observations from 11 laboratory flume experiments, ensemble ML was evaluated with an unseen experiment holdout; CatBoost reached R²=.953 and SHAP identified an approximately 0.3 m cumulative vegetation-exposure threshold associated with deposition-regime change. This is a testable physical hypothesis from a small laboratory dataset, not causal confirmation; independent experiments are needed.
